analysis.title: Share Repurchase Weekly Recap - 26 Oct 2026
key_insights: GS buyback desk activity was steady in the week ending 23 Oct 2026, at 0.7x the 2025 YTD ADTV and 0.7x the 2024 YTD ADTV, skewed toward Financials, Health Care and Consumer Discretionary.
About 27% of the S&P 500 is currently in an open buyback window. GS expects that to nearly double to about 50% by the end of this week as earnings reporting intensifies.
GS expects buyback volumes to pick up into November as corporate windows reopen. November is seasonally the desk's second most active execution month.
Clients are slowly returning to opportunistic open-market flow. Discretionary orders rose to 16% of desk execution versus 84% in 10b5-1 plans, from 15% and 85% the prior week.
New repurchase authorizations were active last week: 26 programs were authorized for a combined $36.1B.
earnings_insights: The earnings reporting calendar intensifies this week, with a substantial portion of the S&P 500 reporting results. About 27% of the index is in an open buyback window now, rising to about 50% by the end of the week.
vol_and_positioning: Buyback desk flow was 0.7x the 2025 YTD ADTV and 0.7x the 2024 YTD ADTV in the week ending 23 Oct 2026.
Execution mix was 16% discretionary and 84% 10b5-1 plans, versus 15% and 85% the prior week.
